claims: TPC Sawgrass is located in Ponte Vedra Beach, Florida.
Ponte Vedra Beach is a coastal town southeast of Jacksonville.
TPC Sawgrass is the home of the PGA Tour headquarters.
TPC Sawgrass is the home of The Players Championship.
TPC Sawgrass is situated off highway A1A.
The address of TPC Sawgrass is 110 Championship Way, Ponte Vedra Beach, FL 32082.
TPC Sawgrass is situated along the Atlantic coast.
TPC Sawgrass is roughly a 60-minute drive from Jacksonville International Airport (JAX).
TPC Sawgrass is best known for the Stadium Course.
The Stadium Course is famous for its island green 17th hole.
TPC Sawgrass is best known for the Dye's Valley Course.
St. Augustine is to the south of TPC Sawgrass.
St. John's Town Center is in Jacksonville.
